description: MoorDyn-C is the FloatingArrayDesign project's lumped-mass model of moorings attached to floating offshore structures, developed with national-laboratory and marine-engineering contributors. It represents axial stiffness, damping, buoyancy, Morison hydrodynamic forces and seabed contact. Inputs describe connected lines, clump weights, floats, rods and bodies in a MAP-derived text format; the model calculates mooring-system motion and forces for coupling with structural simulations. Spatial coverage is the configured offshore installation, with time resolution selected for the dynamic experiment. Free BSD-3-Clause source can be built as a C++ library or wrapped for Python, Fortran and MATLAB. A limitation is that users must distinguish the C and Fortran input conventions and confirm supported hydrodynamic assumptions for their version. The README describes a calm-water assumption. MoorDyn-C supports floating-energy infrastructure simulations and couples with WEC-Sim (platform-wec-sim). No model was installed or run.
